requirement: Stop keeps a site call that was not yet sent from being sent; a write already on the wire is not sent twice

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: no site tool read the turn's abort signal; a write waiting for the lease landed up to 100 s after Stop while the session log said the call was aborted
oracle.invariant: S1: the call answers TURN_STOPPED at once and nothing more is sent. S2: the write runs to its answer and no second send follows; a lost answer stays unknown. S3: the write on the wire lands; no later write or undo is sent. S4: nothing runs in the site container.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
